title: Cloud NAT: The Complete Beginner's Guide

scenes.narration: Your servers have no public addresses. But they still need to download updates. Cloud N A T lets them out, safely.

scenes.heading: The mailroom underground
scenes.narration: Cloud NAT is a one way door. It gives private V Ms outbound internet access. Nothing from the internet can start a connection in. Private Google Access reaches Google's own services privately. So private V Ms can still use Google A P Is.

items.real: No public IP on the VM

scenes.heading: Common mix-ups
scenes.narration: Three traps. It's outbound only. They don't need public addresses. It uses Google's internal network.

items.wrong: Private Google Access uses the internet

scenes.heading: Remember this
scenes.cta: Try the Courseiva Cloud NAT lab
scenes.narration: So, to recap. Cloud N A T gives outbound access only. V Ms keep no public address. Private Google Access reaches Google A P Is. Ready to practise? Try the Courseiva Cloud NAT lab.
